summary: "六祖壇經" by Huineng is a Chan Buddhist scripture composed in China between the 8th and 13th century. The only Chinese Buddhist text explicitly called a "Sutra," it centers on teachings attributed to the sixth Chan patriarch Huineng. The text explores the concept of Buddha-nature, invisible to humans only through their illusions.
